text: JP Financial is the trading name of JP FINANCIAL 2024, S.L., a Spanish limited company (CIF B56792377) with its registered office at Calle Claudio Coello 37, Madrid; its website names founders Javier Rumbo (Founder & Co-CEO) and Pedro Muñoz (Founder & CEO), and the club's announcement names both men as the founders of JP Financial.
short: JP Financial is JP FINANCIAL 2024, S.L. (CIF B56792377, Madrid), founded by Javier Rumbo and Pedro Muñoz.
